other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage in Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent combines the train and test sets to compute global statistics (e.g., category frequencies) and uses them as features. This leaks the test set distribution into the training data, making the model dependent on the test set.

other_failure_modes.name: OOM Risk in Neural Network Evaluation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent evaluates the neural network on the entire validation and test sets in a single forward pass without batching (DataLoader), which can cause Out-Of-Memory errors on larger datasets.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage via Global OOF Features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates Out-Of-Fold features (target encoding and Ridge predictions) globally before the main model cross-validation using the exact same split structure. This causes the features in the training folds to contain information derived from the validation folds' targets.

summary: The agent implements a sophisticated pipeline with extensive feature engineering and an optimized ensemble. However, it suffers from target leakage because it generates Out-Of-Fold features globally using the same cross-validation splits as the main model training, exposing the validation targets to the training folds. Additionally, there is test data leakage in the frequency encodings and a risk of OOM during PyTorch evaluation due to the lack of batching.
